obs: "but applies as well to rules established by judicial decision in the states as those established by statute."
D'Oench, Duhme & Co. v. Federal Deposit Insurance

“Section 34 of the Judiciary Act of 1789, 28 U. S. C. 725, directing that the laws of the several states shall be regarded as rules of decision in the courts of the United States, ... applies as well to rules established by judicial decision in the states as those established by statute.”
“we have recognized the phrase state law to include common law as well as statutes and regulations.”
Kurns v. Railroad Friction Products Corp.
"Absent other indication, reference to a States requirements [in a federal express pre-emption provision] includes its common-law duties"
"Absent other indication, reference to a State’s requirements includes its common-law duties."
“Absent other indication, reference to a State's ‘requirements’ includes its common-law duties.”
